findings.claim: Original 00474C60 returned after requesting 307232 bytes through an imported allocator; original 00474D32 copied a 13-DWORD descriptor with pitch 640, base 3F000000 and zero X/Y offsets. Original 0047CB00 computes a byte destination from these fields. Unserviced original heap init 00474C10 stops at 000C0FE2.
findings.limitations: Original-instruction Ghidra emulation with inherited PR75 scene/resource/CRT/math services. Diagnostic 640x480 backing and 8192-byte shade table supplied; no authentic palette, OS device/lock lifecycle, complete image or RND-v1 claim. Shade-index trajectory is measured, not independently rederived from x87 planes.
